component.name: Linal
component.summary: Private messages and calls with Signal

description.p: A native GTK/libadwaita Signal client for the Librem 5. Your phone is the Signal device: register your number on the phone with SMS verification. Signal's captcha is solved once on a computer or another phone on the same Wi-Fi and handed to the phone automatically.

ul.li: One-to-one and group chats with photos and files
Replies, reactions, delete for everyone, read receipts and typing indicators
Voice calls with earpiece, speaker and mute
Start chats from your phone's contacts
Notifications and incoming calls even when the app is closed

description.p: Linal is an unofficial client built on signal-cli; it is not affiliated with Signal Messenger LLC.
Signal-L5 is now called Linal. Newly registered accounts no longer hang on mobile networks with broken IPv6.
New Log out option. Logging out, or signing in with a different number, deletes everything of the previous account from the phone.
Registration no longer fails or repeats itself after the SMS code is filled in automatically.
Registering on the phone itself works again: the captcha opens in the app, which collects the link directly.
Developer option for testing registration against the Signal staging service.
Register by solving the captcha on a computer or another phone on the same Wi-Fi.
Fixes an extra restart of the Signal service after a failed registration.
Save logs for support (kept on your phone), a prompt to set your profile name, and fixed duplicate incoming-call notifications.
Security fixes: other apps and web pages can no longer control your account or answer calls, and message text is no longer written to the system log. Registration uses your default browser again.
Fixes Firefox reporting "already running" when reopening the captcha.
Registration uses Firefox for the captcha and shows clear errors.
Registration uses your default browser (GNOME Web).
First release: messaging, attachments, reactions, voice calls, contacts, notifications and on-device registration.
